notes.title: Update 0.5.4 : Mutation Tree
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Mutation Tree is now fully available (meta progression)

Added Steam Achievements (currently 33, more to come)

Enabled Steam Cloud Save

Made the quests icons appearance more obvious to the eye

notes.title: Patch 0.5.3: QoL Improvements and Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 Modified behavior and look of Holy Spear (Spear stuck bug fixed by new behavior) 
 Added Screen Shake Intensity setting
 Fixed UI reload bar disappears randomly
 Fixed Pyromania and Danse Macabre don't count kills as Zone Ability for Amulet of Equity
 Added a Toggle Auto Aim button key
 Fixed Quest indicators out of screen on non 16/9 resolutions, added indicator animation to make it more obvious to the eye
 Equipments QoL: Added rarity color indicator directly on slots, buy status indicator on equipment tooltip, warning before quitting run if forgot to send anyting to merchant
 Fixed Buy or Equip same equipment with different rarities bug
 Fixed Base stat upgrade Dash Cooldown inversed (Grace)
 Fixed Unequip item + Throw in garbage removes stats twice


Next update is coming very soon and will feature Mutations Tree, Steam Cloud Save, Steam Achievements and more.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 New custom damage text rendering system (internal engine damage text rendering was subject to crashes in late game)
 Fixed a crash related to a multithread race condition while dealing damage in crowded situations
 Fixed a crash related to bullet bounce in crowded situations
 Fixed a crash related to particle instances 
 Fixed a crash related to SIMD support (SSE4 and AVX2)


This patch should resolve all crash cases known at the moment. Hunting and fixing these crashes took me longer that planned, but the game should be a lot more stable now, and will allow me to focus on less urgent bugfixes, QoL improvements and new content.

Cheers,
Max

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

- Game now saves progression to the save file after each run. This should prevent players to lose progression of multiple runs after an eventual crash

- Fixed a crash happening when too much damage text elements appeared on the screen at once

- French Localization fix for Weapon Mods

notes.title: Prologue REDUX Update
notes.notes:
Greetings folks, long time no see!

I've been hard at work trying to improve the Demo while advancing on the main game.
Thank you for your many feedbacks, I hope this new version addresses some of the problems you raised and will renew your interest for the game!

Release Note:

- Controller Support (Integration with UI is not ideal right now, will rework it later on)
- Auto Aim / Auto Attack / Auto Reload Settings
- Complete overhaul of the upgrade system: no more upgrade trees, progression is now made through multi level stats upgrades, abilities unlocked via tomes, and equipment you can loot
- New inventory system: loot equipment and buy it in the lobby to keep it in between runs
- Random mini quests: explore the map to find Ability Tomes, Mineral Nests to destroy, Equipment Chests, Health Potions and Gold Bags
- New Meta Progression systems: Gather demon hearts to unlock mutations, and minerals to craft weapon mods (resource gathering is functional, lobby UI is not available in the demo, will be in the full game)
- New Health Regeneration System and Health Potions you can loot
- No more slowing down when shooting
- New Dash Mechanic
- New Critical Damage Mechanic: Chance to apply a damage bonus when hitting an enemy
- New Armor Mechanic: Reduces damage taken
- Pause menu now displays a recap of current upgrades / abilities, as well as the inventory
- Boss and Elites now have a health bar
- Improved aiming and hitboxes

Can't wait to hear your feedback on this new version!

Hope you enjoy, see you soon,
Max
